title: When the Provision Wakes
premise: Sebastian Villalobos and his ragtag storm-chasing crew, drowning in debt to the Delgado syndicate, accept a salvage contract from old rival Imogen Reyes: recover the black box from the Meridian Star, a wreck in the Coral Verge that the crew swore off after a death six years ago. Racing a rival salvage fleet and the monsoon clock of six tides, they discover the box contains evidence that Imogen herself helped sink the ship — and that their lost crewmate may have died covering it up. In the final storm, Sebastian must choose between delivering the box to clear his debts or broadcasting the truth, and the crew escapes the wreck as the monsoon swallows it, broke but free.
about_author: A. M. Hartwell is the pen name of a former maritime insurance investigator who spent a decade documenting shipwreck claims across the South Pacific. Hartwell now writes adventure fiction from a houseboat, drawing on real salvage disputes and the people who chase them.

chapters.title: The Debt Collector Smiles
chapters.summary: Sebastian Villalobos POV. A Delgado syndicate enforcer visits the crew's dockside shack with a cheerful ultimatum: pay in thirty days or lose the boat and their fingers. Sebastian masks fear with bravado while the crew watches. Emotional beat: the suffocating pressure of debt and the fragile pride that keeps the crew together.

chapters.title: Salt in the Old Wounds
chapters.summary: Imogen Reyes POV. Imogen, now flush with syndicate money, approaches Sebastian with the Meridian Star salvage contract — the wreck they swore off after Tomás's death. Sebastian refuses; she reminds him of the debt. Emotional beat: bitter history resurfacing, old grief weaponized.

chapters.title: A Vote in the Rain
chapters.summary: Crew POV (narrated through navigator Priya). The crew debates taking the job: engineer Bo needs surgery money, deckhand Kip wants revenge answers, Priya smells a trap. They vote yes, four to one. Emotional beat: loyalty strained by desperation, the oath broken by need.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: Sebastian POV. The crew charts the route to the Coral Verge as meteorologists confirm monsoon landfall in six tides. A rival fleet, the Corvus, is already underway with syndicate backing. Emotional beat: the clock starts, dread braided with adrenaline.

chapters.title: The Sworn-Off Sea
chapters.summary: Priya POV. Crossing into waters where Tomás died, the crew's silence turns heavy. Kip sabotages nothing but nearly fights Bo over the past. Sebastian admits he never read Tomás's final log. Emotional beat: grief as ballast they all carry differently.

chapters.title: First Tide: The Corvus on the Horizon
chapters.summary: Bo POV. The rival fleet shadows them; a syndicate cutter boards briefly, 'inspecting papers,' and leaves a warning. Bo discovers someone tampered with their radio. Emotional beat: paranoia taking hold — the enemy is inside the weather.

chapters.title: Second Tide: The Grave Marker
chapters.summary: Kip POV. They pass the reef where Tomás's skiff washed up. Kip, who was closest to him, breaks down and reveals Tomás radioed something strange the night he died. Emotional beat: guilt and the first crack in the official story.

chapters.title: Third Tide: Into the Verge
chapters.summary: Priya POV. Navigating the Coral Verge's drowned labyrinth, they find the Meridian Star wedged in a trench — and evidence the Corvus divers have already been down once and failed. Emotional beat: awe curdling into suspicion about what's worth this risk.

chapters.title: The Box That Sings
chapters.summary: Sebastian POV. Sebastian and Kip dive and recover the black box, but its casing bears syndicate seals. On ascent, a Corvus chase boat rams their tender; Kip is injured. Emotional beat: triumph immediately taxed — nothing is won clean.

chapters.title: Imogen's Ledger
chapters.summary: Imogen POV. Aboard her support ship, Imogen reveals partial truth: the box holds proof the Meridian Star was scuttled for insurance, and the syndicate wants it silenced. She claims she's redeeming herself. Sebastian doesn't believe her. Emotional beat: loyalty versus truth — every ally is a question mark.

chapters.title: Fourth Tide: The Recording
chapters.summary: Priya POV. The crew plays the box in secret: they hear the scuttling order — and Tomás's voice, refusing it, minutes before the ship went down. He didn't die by accident; he died resisting. Emotional beat: grief transfigured into fury and purpose.

chapters.title: The Offer
chapters.summary: Sebastian POV. The Delgado enforcer arrives by seaplane: deliver the box intact and all debts vanish; broadcast it and the syndicate hunts them all. Imogen urges delivery; Kip urges broadcast; Priya calculates they can't outrun the monsoon with either choice. Emotional beat: the love-versus-duty fault line opens inside the crew itself.

chapters.title: Fifth Tide: Mutiny Weather
chapters.summary: Bo POV. Bo, secretly syndicate-indebted too, considers stealing the box overnight — then instead warns Sebastian that the Corvus plans to board at dawn. The crew locks down the boat. Emotional beat: a betrayer choosing loyalty at the last hinge.

chapters.title: The Corvus Boards
chapters.summary: Kip POV. The Corvus assault comes with the rising wind; a brutal close-quarters fight in the rigging. They repel the boarders but lose their tender and half their fuel. Imogen's ship abandons them. Emotional beat: betrayal crystallizing — they are alone against fleet and storm.

chapters.title: Imogen's Confession
chapters.summary: Imogen POV, via a broken radio transmission. Imogen admits she signed the scuttling order as a young officer and has spent six years buying her way back to the wreck to destroy the proof. She begs Sebastian to let her. Emotional beat: the rival unmasked as the most broken person aboard this story.

chapters.title: Sixth Tide: The Wall of Water
chapters.summary: Priya POV. The monsoon's leading edge hits early. The Corvus turns back; the crew must choose: run for shelter and lose the box to the syndicate's waiting cutter, or ride the storm's eye to the one relay tower that can broadcast the recording. Emotional beat: terror and clarity arriving together.

chapters.title: Through the Eye
chapters.summary: Sebastian POV. The crew threads the storm's eye — the wildest passage of their lives, Bo jury-rigging the engine, Priya navigating by lightning flash. They reach the relay tower as the eye closes. Emotional beat: the crew becoming one organism; love against duty resolved into shared purpose.

chapters.title: What Tomás Knew
chapters.summary: Kip POV. Broadcasting the full recording, including Tomás's defiance, Kip speaks his eulogy over open frequencies — every ship in the Verge hears the truth, including the syndicate's own crews. Emotional beat: grief finally given a voice; truth as an act of love.

chapters.title: The Wreck Claims Its Own
chapters.summary: Imogen POV. Imogen takes a skiff into the collapsing storm toward the Meridian Star, choosing to go down with her confession. Sebastian tries to stop her; she smiles and cuts the line. Emotional beat: devastating release — atonement that no one can forgive for her.

chapters.title: The Long Way Home
chapters.summary: Priya POV. The crew limps home through the monsoon's aftermath, broke, battered, and expecting syndicate retribution. Instead, the recording has turned Delgado's own sailors into witnesses; the syndicate goes quiet. Emotional beat: exhausted, improbable survival.

chapters.title: Settlement
chapters.summary: Sebastian POV. The crew pays the syndicate nothing; the debt dissolves in scandal. They repair the boat, bury Kip's grudge, and vote on a new oath — no more sworn-off seas, only honest ones. Emotional beat: belonging rebuilt on truth instead of silence.

chapters.title: When the Provision Wakes
chapters.summary: Sebastian POV, coda. A season later, a letter arrives from a maritime court: Tomás is posthumously cleared, and the Meridian Star's insurers are under investigation. Sebastian reads it on the dock at dawn as a storm builds far out at sea — and the crew, smiling, starts the engine toward it. Emotional beat: the wilderness forgets nothing, but neither do they; the chase, honestly chosen, goes on.
